items.title: Tee Higgins: Deemed Questionable after Friday 'DNP'
items.text:
After not practicing Friday, Higgins (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints, Katherine Terrell of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tetairoa McMillan: Limited at Friday's practice
items.text:

items.title: Jordan Addison: Out again in Week 12
items.text:
